Subject of mockeries, even from his disciples. |mob_level = 430-982 |id = LIVID_1, LIVID_CLONE_1, MASTER_LIVID_1, MASTER_LIVID_CLONE_1 }} '''Livid''' is the {{mcat|b}} of [[The Catacombs - Floor V]]. == Collection == Killing Livid increases the Livid collection. {{CollectionTable|Livid}} {{/Collection UI}} == Boss Fight == === Overview === [[File:Thorn Orb.png|thumb|100px|The remains of Thorn]] Livid reveals a Dark Orb in the center of the arena as the remains of [[Thorn]] and that he is using its power to clone himself. After {{Green|16s}}, he blinds everyone for {{Green|1s}} and spawns eight clones from Endermen. Each of these clones has the same amount of health and stats, but they have different nametag colors. The real Livid can be identified by looking at the color of the ceiling once the clones have spawned. When players kill a clone, it will regenerate all the way back to full HP and heal nearby clones by 25% of their maximum health. In [[Master Mode]], all Livids will also gain a {{Stat|Damage}} boost when a clone dies. Like Thorn, Livid has only one phase, which ends when the real Livid is killed (causing all clones to despawn). Unlike other bosses, the boss bar does not show Livid's remaining {{Stat|Health}}, so players cannot determine which entity is him by damaging them separately. === Clones === [[File:Livid Enderman Clone.png|thumb|x200px|The Livid Enderman clone]] Each of the clones has a unique combat trait. {| class="wikitable" !Image !Name !Trait |- |[[File:Vendetta Livid.png|center|50px]] |Vendetta Livid |Can teleport around and throw a Dagger at players. |- |[[File:Crossed Livid.png|center|50px]] |{{Pink|Crossed Livid}} |Grants the Blindness effect to his target. |- |[[File:Hockey Livid.png|center|50px]] |{{Red|Hockey Livid}} |Charges at players, dealing damage. |- |[[File:Doctor Livid.png|center|50px]] |{{Grey|Doctor Livid}} |Can throw a Splash Potion of Harming, dealing True Damage. |- |[[File:Frog Livid.png|center|50px]] |{{DarkGreen|Frog Livid}} |Can poison players. |- |[[File:Smile Livid.png|center|50px]] |{{Green|Smile Livid}} |Can throw a Splash Potion of Slowness. |- |[[File:Scream Livid.png|center|50px]] |{{Blue|Scream Livid}} |Can emit a knockback circle that deals True Damage and knocks back anyone in the vicinity. |- |[[File:Purple Livid.png|center|50px]] |{{Purple|Purple Livid}} |Leeches HP from targets. |- |[[File:Arcade Livid.png|center|50px]] |{{Yellow|Arcade Livid}} |Moves strangely and can shoot players with a bow. |} === Master Mode Changes === * Each '''Livid''' has {{Stat|Health|600,000,000}} and a base {{Stat|Damage}} of {{Stat|Damage|216,000|icononly=yes}}. * All Livids will also gain a {{Stat|Damage}} boost when a clone dies. == Drops == Killing a Livid grants the following drops: {{Mob Drops Table |level = 430-982 |coins = 1,075-2,455 |combat_xp = 3,225-7,365 |orbs = 1,290-2,946 }} Defeating the correct Livid will also complete the fight, unlocking [[Dungeon Reward Chest]]s with their own loot: {{:The Catacombs - There, he became a member when only 15 years old. He received his first assassination contract at the age of 17, directly from the Guild's leader. While Livid was a very skilled thief, this was going to be his first murder, and he enjoyed it, seeing it as art. Over the years, he started to think it was too easy for him, and sought more challenging kills. One night, he went to an [[Wilderness#Tavern|Inn]] to murder someone. Sitting at a table, he noticed [[Necron|a mysterious man]] come in, which was Necron before fully withering. Livid noticed that he hid a small chest in a long black cape. Very soon after Necron came in, Livid noticed [[The Watcher|another man]] was following him and studying Necron for almost an hour. This was Lathrop, the man that becomes the Watcher. After Necron suddenly left his table and went upstairs, Livid decided to learn more about him. He sat down with Lathrop, pretending to be drunk. He learned that Necron was "a merchant from far away." Livid decided that he would kill Necron as he was a "perfect target." Livid went to Necron's room from the outside and saw that he was sleeping, but there was no sign of the small chest. He readied [[Livid Dagger|his dagger]] to strike, when his concentration was halted by a sound coming from an already inspected empty corner. Livid knew that sound does not come from thin air, unless magic is involved. The body in the bed was gone, and Livid felt himself being cut in half with no time to react. This was Necron. The blade was pulled out, no blood flowed, and Livid couldn't feel his body anymore. His killer, [[Necron]], then took his body with him to [[The Catacombs]]. Necron quickly noticed he was followed by [[The Watcher|Lathrop]], after questioning him, Necron decided to take Lathrop with him to [[The Wither King|his Master]]. Livid then became a Master Necromancer, training disciples, presumably for Necron's army. However his subjects were not loyal to him and mock him. The reasons for this are currently unknown. == Trivia == *The Livid Clones each have references in them. **Vendetta Livid wears a Guy Fawkes Mask, a reference to Guy Fawkes in the Gunpowder Plot in 1605. ** Frog Livid wears a mask that looks very similar to the meme, Pepe the Frog. ** Scream Livid wears a mask that is inspired by the painting, "The Scream" by Edvard Munch. **Crossed Livid’s mask is inspired by Día de los Muertos. **Smile Livid is likely a reference to the YouTuber Dream. ** Hockey Livid’s behavior and name are likely a reference to the infamous fights that are known to occur in professional hockey. **Arcade Livid's mask references the classic arcade game, Space Invaders. **Doctor Livid's mask is face mask used to protect from disease and keep environments sterile. *Livid is the only human in the Blood Room that does not speak. * Livid's shadows he was talking about in his defeat speech could be [[Shadow Assassin]]s. *Livid had an Opti Fine cape of the flag of India. **On February 5, 2021, Reddit user u/TeamSyringe [https://www.reddit.com/r/HypixelSkyblock/comments/ldoqnw/guess_who_is_indian_now/ purchased the cape]. * Livid holds a Shadow Fury or a Silent Death instead of Livid dagger, boss fight and watcher summoned. **This is contradictory of the fact he calls his swords “Daggers”. *When Livid summoned as Undead is defeated, it doesn't add to the collection. *Livid's quote, "[https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/darth-sidious-unlimited-power Unlimited power!]" is a quote Star Wars, used by [[fandom:starwars:Darth_Sidious|Darth Sidious]], most notably in [[fandom:starwars:Star_Wars:_Episode_III_Revenge_of_the_Sith|Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith]] said shortly after [[fandom:starwars:Mace_Windu|Mace Windu]] loses his hand. ==
